pursuit: Gen 7 workspace-vs-starter router — move coverage_lift_per_promote (single-family promotes don't absorb workspace-classified demand)

base.note: Gen 6 evolve shipped 5 auto-promotes + nightly autonomy; coverage_lift_per_promote stays 0 because workspace router dispatches generic [nextjs-ts, api-service] for most real user prompts, bypassing newly-promoted domain-specific families (kyc-onboarding, fraud-ops-console, polymarket-portfolio-hedging).

harnessPathRationale: Single highest-blast-radius file for routing. Workspace-vs-starter decision lives in planWorkspacePrompt vs planSingleStarter. Variants will conflict on this file → worktree isolation per multi-pursue protocol.

dimensionClaims.coverage_lift_per_promote: Fraction of previously-unrouted buildout scenarios that now route to a domain-specific family. If this moves, registry expansion ABSORBS demand instead of accumulating unused entries. Target 0.10 (≥2.6 of 26 unrouted scenarios).
dimensionClaims.routing_stability: Count of previously-routed scenarios whose family choice FLIPPED or was LOST. Regressions destroy trust in routing determinism. Hard floor: 0 flipped-to-worse, 0 lost-routes on the 28 currently-routed scenarios.
dimensionClaims.test_suite_pass: Full test suite must stay 100% green. Routing changes frequently regress coverage.test.ts which pins specific prompts → specific families. Target 688/688 (current suite size).

constraints: Variants MUST edit src/lib/prompt-planner.ts or its direct collaborators (src/lib/planner/*.ts, src/lib/keywords.ts).
Variants MUST NOT regress routing_stability — any lost route or flipped-to-worse route auto-rejects the variant.
Variants MUST preserve backward-compatible workspace mode for multi-lane prompts (mcp+dspy+zk workspace dispatch).
No LLM calls introduced in the hot path. The router must remain synchronous + deterministic.
